title: skeleton skybox with distorted music
features: just a skeleton skybox and a distorted music

task.spawn(function()
for i,v in pairs(game.Workspace:GetChildren()) do
if v.className == "Sound" then
v:Stop()
v:Remove()    
end    
end
wait()
Spooky = Instance.new("Sound", game.Workspace)
Spooky.Name = "Spooky"
Spooky.SoundId = "rbxassetid://104835515231080"
Spooky.Pitch = 1
Spooky.TimePosition = 8.6
Spooky.Volume = 1
Spooky.Playing = true
local distortion = Instance.new("DistortionSoundEffect")
distortion.Level = 2.51
distortion.Parent = Spooky
while wait(104.8) do
Spooky:Destroy()
Spooky = Instance.new("Sound", game.Workspace)
Spooky.Name = "Spooky"

Spooky.Volume = 1
Spooky.Playing = true
local distortion = Instance.new("DistortionSoundEffect")
distortion.Level = 2.51

end
